title: 第一卷 第45章 大哥要一起不第一卷 第44章 九灵粥
lines: 一炷香后。
秦绝方才缓缓走来。
洪铁虎等人一个个满目激动，精神烁烁。
“少爷！”
眼见秦绝来了，众人单手持刀，左手成拳抵胸，恭敬作礼。
秦绝淡笑道：“想来你们已经感受到身体的变化了，接下来这段时间，要更努力的修炼，争取早日突破。”
“回少爷，这变化，简直是脱胎换骨一般！而且，属下隐隐有种感觉，属下好像快要破境了！”洪铁虎激动道。
“师父，您要晋入大宗师境了？”
“太好了！”
洪家子弟惊喜不已。
踏入了大宗师境，在凤州这块地域，就是站到武力巅峰了！
秦绝微笑道：“如今你气血强盛，经路宽韧，也确实满足破境的条件了。”
洪铁虎眼眶微红道：“这一切都要多谢少爷！若非少爷助我等炼体，让我等肉身有了脱胎换骨的大造化，属下这身子恐怕调养数年，也只能勉强恢复到当年巅峰，哪敢奢望破境。”
他是真的感激秦绝。
不仅仅是因为实力提升了，而是破境之后，他才真的有希望能够报仇！
秦绝淡笑道：“机会我会给，气靠自己争。只要够忠心，肯努力，我秦府不会亏待了任何人。”
“我等愿为少爷效死！”洪铁虎等人郑重道。
秦绝点头道：“回去你们自己的地方，继续修炼去吧！”
洪铁虎等人退走。
黄刚这才激动的搓了搓手，上前嘿笑道：“大哥，他们手里的大刀是你给的吧？弟弟也想要一柄。”
秦绝摇头道：“这虎魄斩魂刀，是我秦府护卫的专属战刀。他们习练的刀法，也是不外传的。”
黄刚嘿笑道：“这简单啊，大哥把我招了，我也当秦府的护卫就是。”
秦绝轻笑道：“你脑子有包啊，好好的黄少不做，要来我秦府当护卫。就算你真想来，我还怕你祸害小青、小荷呢。”
小青、小荷脸色一白，连忙道：“少爷，那可不能招他。我们可是小姐的丫鬟，就算要被祸害，也只能被少爷祸害……”
说到最后，二人都是脸色羞红的低下了头，声音也是越来越轻。
瞧这样子，像是盼着被秦绝祸害一样。
秦绝嘴角一抽，他就和黄刚开个玩笑罢了。
黄刚哈哈笑道：“大哥，这个你完全可以放心，她们两个胸脯没肉，根本不是我喜欢的类型。大哥，你就收了我吧，反正我已经决定了，这辈子就跟着大哥后面混了，再添个秦府护卫的名头，那也无所谓的啊！”
秦绝淡笑道：“护卫你是当不了了。但如果你能炼制出玄品丹药，我可以收你进秦府当个客卿。到时候，送你一柄虎魄斩魂刀，也未尝不可。”
黄刚脸色一苦：“大哥，你这不是为难我吗？我要是能炼制出玄品丹药，他们还会在背地里叫我废物吗？”
秦绝淡淡道：“菜就多炼，反正你爷爷那里材料多，经得住你浪费。这几日的闭关淬体，对你们的好处，可不仅仅只是力量上的提升，而是整个肉身的全面蜕变。等你回去炼上几炉丹药，你就会发现自己和以往的差别。”
黄刚闻言，轻吸一口气，郑重道：“好，既然大哥这么说了，那我明日就开始好好炼丹，争取早日炼出玄品丹药来！”
content_en:
After a stick of incense.
Qin Jue just walked slowly over.
Hong Tiehu and others were all excited and their spirits were shining.
"Master!"
Seeing Qin Jue coming, everyone held a sword in one hand, put their left hand into a fist on their chest, and saluted respectfully.
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "I guess you have already felt the changes in your body. In the next period of time, you must practice harder and strive for an early breakthrough."
"Back to the young master, this change is like a complete rebirth! Moreover, I have a vague feeling that I am about to break through!" Hong Tiehu said excitedly.
"Master, are you going to advance to the Grand Master realm?"
"Great!"
The children of the Hong family were pleasantly surprised.
After entering the Grand Master Realm, you have reached the pinnacle of martial arts in Fengzhou!
Qin Jue smiled and said: "Now that your energy and blood are strong and your path is wide and tough, you have indeed met the conditions for breaking through."
Hong Tiehu's eyes were slightly red and he said: "I owe all of this to you, Master! If it weren't for Master's help in refining my body and making my body completely transformed, my body would have been recuperating for several years, and I would have been able to barely return to its peak. How dare I hope to break through."
He was really grateful to Qin Jue.
Not only because his strength has improved, but after breaking through, he really hopes to take revenge!
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "I will give you the opportunity, and you have to fight for it yourself. As long as you are loyal enough and willing to work hard, my Qin family will not treat anyone badly."
"We are willing to die for the young master!" Hong Tiehu and others solemnly said.
Qin Jue nodded and said: "Go back to your own place and continue practicing!"
"Yes!"
Hong Tiehu and others retreated.
Huang Gang rubbed his hands excitedly, stepped forward and said with a smile: "Brother, you gave them the big sword in their hands, right? My younger brother wants one too."
Qin Jue shook his head and said: "This Tiger Soul-Slaying Sword is the exclusive sword for the guards of my Qin Mansion. The sword skills they practice are not allowed to be passed on to others."
Huang Gang chuckled and said, "It's easy. Brother recruited me, and I will be the guard of the Qin Mansion."
Qin Jue chuckled and said: "You have a big idea. If you don't do well, Mr. Huang, you want to come to my Qin Mansion as a guard. Even if you really want to come, I'm still afraid that you will harm Xiao Qing and Xiao He."
Xiao Qing and Xiao He turned pale and said quickly: "Master, you can't recruit him. We are the lady's maids. Even if we are going to be harmed, we can only be harmed by the young master..."
At the end of the sentence, both of them lowered their heads with blushing faces, and their voices became softer and softer.
Looking at this, it looks like he is expecting to be harmed by Qin Jue.
Qin Jue's mouth twitched, and he was just joking with Huang Gang.
Huang Gang laughed and said: "Brother, you can rest assured about this. The two of them have no breasts and are not my type at all. Brother, just accept me. Anyway, I have decided that I will follow my brother for the rest of my life. It doesn't matter if I add the title of Qin Mansion guard!"
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "You can't be a guard anymore. But if you can refine the Xuanpin elixir, I can accept you into the Qin Mansion as a guest. When the time comes, it wouldn't be a bad idea to give you a Tiger Soul-Severing Knife."
Huang Gang's expression turned bitter: "Brother, aren't you making things difficult for me? If I could refine the Xuanpin elixir, would they still call me a waste behind my back?"
Qin Jue said calmly: "You need to refine more dishes. Anyway, your grandfather has a lot of materials and can withstand your waste. The benefits of these few days of seclusion and body tempering are not just an improvement in strength, but a comprehensive transformation of the entire body. When you go back and refine a few furnaces of elixirs, you will find that you are different from before."
Huang Gang heard the words, took a breath, and said solemnly: "Okay, since the elder brother said so, I will start refining the elixir tomorrow and strive to refine the Xuanpin elixir as soon as possible!"
